close_reason: Added OID_EXT_EXTENDED_KEY_USAGE to CRITICAL_OK_LEAF_EXTENSIONS and HANDLED_CRITICAL_OIDS; updated crate doc to not overclaim TLS support.
description: CRITICAL_OK_LEAF_EXTENSIONS omits OID_EXT_EXTENDED_KEY_USAGE. CA/B Forum TLS and code-signing certificates routinely mark EKU as critical. Any such cert passed to verify_simple returns Error::UnhandledCriticalExtension { index: 0 }. The crate-level doc says it is for 'TLS and code-signing chains' — this is the exact class of chains that will be rejected. Users following the README quick-start will hit this immediately with any real CA-issued cert. Maintenance consequence: flood of confused issue reports from users whose real-world TLS chain is rejected by the 'TLS chain' crate.
title: pkix-chain-simple rejects critical EKU — contradicts 'TLS chains' doc claim
